about_short_description.short_description: Material Depot is a marketplace that offers curated collections, 3D visualisation, and building materials for home improvement requirements.

identifier.value: Discovery Engine and AI Design Tools

product.name: Discovery Engine and AI Design Tools
product.description: A SaaS platform that provides a discovery engine and AI-powered design tools for home improvement material selection and design.

product.name: Tiles
product.description: A range of ceramic, vitrified, and 3D tiles for floors and walls in various finishes and sizes.

product.name: Laminates
product.description: Decorative laminates in various designs, finishes, and thicknesses for interior surfaces like furniture and walls.

product.name: Panels and Louvers
product.description: Various interior and exterior panels and louvers made from materials like wood, PVC, WPC, and charcoal for cladding and decorative purposes.

product.name: Plywood and Blockboards
product.description: Various grades of plywood and blockboards including waterproof, water-resistant, calibrated, and craft plywood for construction and furniture making.

product.name: Wooden Flooring and Wood-Look Tiles
product.description: Wooden flooring products and tiles that mimic wood appearance for flooring applications in various interior spaces.
